visual_designs.content_arrangement: Action title displayed as a powerful statement in large typography. No bullet points. The statement itself is the visual. Dark background with white text for dramatic impact.
visual_designs.justification: Opening slide should create immediate emotional impact. A single powerful statement (layout: statement) conveys the paradox of 'world-class talent + isolation' more effectively than any diagram. The 3-second rule: audience grasps the tension immediately.

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid graph TD A["2004年
運営費交付金"] -->|"累計 -1,400億円"| B["現在"] B --> C["学会参加費 削減"] B --> D["国際会議渡航費 削減"] B --> E["共同研究予算 削減"] C --> F["研究者の孤立"] D --> F E --> F style A fill:#4a90d9,stroke:#333,color:#fff style B fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#333,color:#fff style F fill:#2c3e50,stroke:#333,color:#fff ```
visual_designs.content_arrangement: Left column: Mermaid flowchart showing budget cut cascade leading to isolation. Right column: Two large statistics displayed vertically - '2位→4位 (論文数)' and '4位→10位 (Top10%論文)' with downward arrows for visual impact.
visual_designs.justification: One Chart, One Message: Budget cuts → reduced opportunities → isolation. The cause-effect relationship is the core insight. Statistics on the right reinforce the consequence without cluttering the diagram.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Central statement: '富山県 / 5年間 / 一人で / EVMコンパイラ' arranged vertically with each element on its own line, creating visual rhythm. Optional: single developer icon or silhouette. No bullet points.
visual_designs.justification: This is a human story, not a process. The power is in the stark facts: location, duration, solitude, achievement. A statement layout lets these facts speak for themselves. One Message: Brilliant talent is isolated in Japan.

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid
graph LR
    subgraph Japan["日本の現状"]
        J1["予算削減"] --> J2["機会減少"]
    end
    
    subgraph Ethereum["イーサリアムの機会"]
        E1["潤沢な助成金"] --> E2["参入者少ない"]
        E2 --> E3["競争優位"]
    end
    
    style J1 fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#333,color:#fff
    style J2 fill:#e74c3c,stroke:#333,color:#fff
    style E1 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#333,color:#fff
    style E2 fill:#27ae60,stroke:#333,color:#fff
    style E3 fill:#f39c12,stroke:#333,color:#fff
```
visual_designs.content_arrangement: Full-width Mermaid diagram showing the contrast between Japan's declining situation (red) and Ethereum's opportunity (green). The visual contrast tells the story: where you are vs. where you could be.
visual_designs.justification: One Chart, One Message: Japan = shrinking, Ethereum = expanding opportunity. The side-by-side contrast using color coding makes the strategic choice visually obvious within 3 seconds.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Action title at top. Three research areas displayed as large cards/blocks with icons: (1) Formal Verification icon + '形式検証', (2) Lock/Key icon + '暗号プリミティブ', (3) Shield icon + 'セキュリティ監査'. Use <v-clicks> to reveal each area sequentially. No traditional bullet points.
visual_designs.justification: This slide lists specific opportunities. Rather than bullets, visual cards with icons create distinct 'zones' for each research area. One Message per card. Sequential reveal maintains audience attention and allows speaker to elaborate on each.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Single powerful statistic in large typography: '20+' (脆弱性報告) centered. Below in smaller text: 'イーサリアムクライアント実装における発見'. This establishes credibility through one concrete number.
visual_designs.justification: One Chart, One Message: Nyx Foundation has proven credibility. The 'fact' layout is designed exactly for this purpose - a single powerful number that establishes authority. No bullets needed; the number speaks for itself.

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid
graph LR
    A["あなた"] --> B["Nyx Foundation"]
    B --> C["助成金情報"]
    B --> D["申請レビュー"]
    B --> E["技術サポート"]
    B --> F["コミュニティ接続"]
    C --> G["グローバル研究コミュニティ"]
    D --> G
    E --> G
    F --> G
    
    style A fill:#3498db,stroke:#333,color:#fff
    style B fill:#9b59b6,stroke:#333,color:#fff

```
visual_designs.content_arrangement: Action title at top. Mermaid diagram centered, showing how Nyx Foundation acts as a bridge between 'you' (the researcher) and the global community, with four specific support channels.
visual_designs.justification: One Chart, One Message: Nyx Foundation is your bridge to global opportunities. The diagram shows the value proposition visually - input (you), hub (Nyx), outputs (4 types of support), destination (global community).

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Central quote in large typography: '一人で研究する時代は終わりを告げようとしている'. This is the philosophical core of the presentation. Clean, minimal, powerful.
visual_designs.justification: This is the manifesto slide - the 'why' behind everything. A statement layout with the core quote creates a moment of reflection. One Message: The paradigm is shifting from isolation to collaboration. No bullets, no diagrams - just the truth.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Left column: Large QR code (placeholder: [QR CODE]) prominently displayed. Right column: Simple text - 'Nyx Foundation Discord' and '今日、第一歩を踏み出そう'. No bullet points. Clear call-to-action.
visual_designs.justification: Final slide = action. The QR code is the visual. Everything else is minimal supporting text. One Message: Scan this now. The two-cols layout gives the QR code prominence while providing context. 3-second rule: see QR → understand action → do it.

bullet_points_minimized.justification: Out of 9 slides, 0 use traditional bullet points. Slide 5 uses styled key points with icons and <v-clicks> instead of plain bullets. All other slides use statement layouts, fact layouts, or Mermaid diagrams. The Jobs principle of 'Show, Don't Tell' has been rigorously applied.

one_chart_one_message_applied.justification: Every visual element conveys exactly one clear message: Slide 2 diagram = 'budget cuts cause isolation', Slide 4 diagram = 'Japan shrinking vs Ethereum growing', Slide 6 fact = 'Nyx has credibility (20+ vulnerabilities)', Slide 7 diagram = 'Nyx bridges you to global community', Slide 8 statement = 'collaboration era is here'. Each can be summarized in one sentence.
